source: generated from storyboard/cat-capture.storyboard.json (rev round-3) by cues-from-storyboard.mjs; lines and anchors are the storyboard's own shots[].vo, shifted onto the delivered timeline (poster card 2.000 s in front, end card 2.000 s at the back)

sections.name: preroll
sections.note: the 2.000 s poster card: the pad and the logo mnemonic only. No kick, no bass, no hats, no plucks; the first hit is on the cut out of the card

sections.name: lift
sections.note: plucks up an octave, FM index down, shimmer in

sections.name: out
sections.note: single hit, then ring out under the end card, which now holds the spoken close

swells.note: reverse swell into the lift and the end card

bed.padNote: the sustained band-limited chord, voiced two and three octaves above the plucks so it lives in 1-4 kHz - the band a voice rest sounds empty in - without touching the 20-200 Hz anti-engine band.

lines.text: Capture keeps the evidence: four tools that take what happened on the page and put it in the session.
Photograph the page takes a picture of what you are testing and keeps it with the session.
Two scopes on the card: the part on screen, or the whole thing.
The whole page is scrolled and stitched into one tall image.
Fixed headers appear once in it, not on every band.
The picture lands in the report, and long forms hide their bugs below the fold.
lines.why: TWO full sets of five draws of "The picture lands in the report, and long forms hide their bugs below the fold." failed the contour gate (+4.1 to +18.1 ST against +1.0). By voice.mjs's own doctrine two failed sets means the WORDING reliably produces the rising terminal, not the weather. A third set is being bought because the alternative is a film with no read at all; if it fails too, this line is the director's to rewrite - it ends on "below the fold", a prepositional tail the model keeps lifting.

lines.text: Record the screen films this tab, or the whole screen, into a video.
Video options first, if you want your microphone, the tab's sound or your webcam.
It runs while you work, and every tab in this window is held.
There is no time limit. Press it again to stop, or let the disk fill.
The video is kept with the session, named for the run that made it.
Check another size opens this same page again in a real window.
Phone, tablet or laptop, at the sizes a browser really has, beside this one.
A real window that really reflows, not a zoomed picture of this one.
It is awake there, and it is masked there, carrying the session on.
What you find is filed under Window sizes, never as a desktop bug.
lines.why: all five draws of "What you find is filed under Window sizes, never as a desktop bug." ended +5.0 to +9.4 ST against a +1.0 ST ceiling.

lines.text: Mask real data covers anything on the page before it is ever recorded.
Click a real name, and a solid block covers the whole of it.
It is covered, not blurred, and it survives every navigation after that.
Every screenshot and every frame of video is taken with the cover on.
Staging is full of real people, and the words underneath never reach the report.
Four tools, and none of what they took leaves this browser.
QA Wrap. Every failure, traced.
lines.delivery: warm, unhurried, final. Not a sell

voice.note: The commercial's final recipe: one Gemini request per line, one voice and one delivery instruction, the gate selecting by shot fit among contour-passing draws, the clean chain with a +6 dB bell at 3.9 kHz whose gain is inside the voice trim.
